lines.zh: 我们八条一起游过菌丝水底。
lines.en: The eight of us swim over the mycelium floor.

lines.zh: 我的背是褐色的，像菌盖。
lines.en: My back is brown, like a mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的岸边全是菌丝块。
lines.en: The mushroom island's shore is all mycelium.
Tiny spores drift in the water.

lines.zh: 我们贴着水底走，不惊动谁。
lines.en: We skim the bottom and disturb nothing.

lines.zh: 我的鳍推开水里一层菌膜。
lines.en: My fins push through a film of fungus.
Giant mushroom roots ahead; we go around.

lines.zh: 这片水只有我们这一群。
lines.en: This water holds only our school.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，孢子跟着打起旋。
lines.en: I flick my tail and the spores swirl.
Brown water, brown me.

lines.zh: 我们排成一列，像一串菌。
lines.en: We line up like a string of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 水面上的岛安静得奇怪。
lines.en: The island above is strangely quiet.

lines.zh: 我游在队伍末尾，慢慢跟。
lines.en: I swim at the tail of the line, trailing.

lines.zh: 菌丝在水底铺成一张毯。
lines.en: Mycelium spreads beneath us like a carpet.

lines.zh: 一节断枝横在水里，我钻了过去。
lines.en: A broken branch lies across the water. I slip past.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，菌丝下的泥轻轻扬起。
lines.en: My tail stirs the silt beneath the mycelium.

lines.zh: 巨菇的菌柄在水里发白。
lines.en: The giant mushroom stems glow pale in the water.

lines.zh: 我们绕过一块菌丝块，继续走。
lines.en: We round a block of mycelium and keep going.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边，吐了个泡。
lines.en: I stop by the weeds and blow a bubble.

lines.zh: 孢子落在我背上，我不抖。
lines.en: Spores settle on my back; I do not shake them off.

lines.zh: 岛上的巨菇在风里吱吱响。
lines.en: The giant mushrooms creak in the wind.
I wait for small insects in the water.

lines.zh: 我们一群挤在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Our school crowds together, warm.
This water tastes of mycelium.
I count the brown mushrooms on the shore.
A mooshroom lows in the distance.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让水从鳃流过。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, letting water pass my gills.
The spots on my back look like tiny caps.
There is not a grain of sand on this bottom.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见孢子落下。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear spores land.
I settle slowly onto the mycelium.
Brown fish, brown island.

lines.zh: 你站在菌丝岸上，很显眼。
lines.en: You stand on the mycelium shore, conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我从菌丝水面上探出半个头。
lines.en: I lift half my head above the mycelium water.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压坏了一片菌丝。
lines.en: Your boots crush a patch of mycelium.

lines.zh: 你是来摘岛上那些褐菇的吗？
lines.en: Have you come to pick the brown mushrooms here?

lines.zh: 我绕着你水中的倒影游。
lines.en: I circle your reflection in the water.
All eight of us stare at you.

lines.zh: 你俯身，倒影落进菌丝水里。
lines.en: You lean over and your reflection sinks into mycelium water.
I know the smell of a fishing net.
You smile; I do not know why.

lines.zh: 我侧身，让你看清背上的斑。
lines.en: I turn so you see the spots on my back.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，背上的斑裂开。
lines.en: The blade lands and a spot on my back splits.

lines.zh: 孢子被我翻起来，水浑了。
lines.en: My thrashing lifts spores; the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我疼得往下沉，贴住菌丝。
lines.en: Pain sinks me flat against the mycelium.
The whole school bursts apart.
That blow nearly turns me belly-up.
Blood mixes with the water, unseen.
I cannot swim; my fins tremble.

lines.zh: 同伴们绕着我不敢靠近。
lines.en: My schoolmates circle but dare not come close.
Your strike is quicker than a water bird's.
I am only a small fish.
Is that a mushroom slice, or a fallen leaf?

lines.zh: 我闻到菌丝的味道，靠过去。
lines.en: I smell mycelium and drift closer.

lines.zh: 你手里捏着一小块褐色东西。
lines.en: You pinch a small brown thing in your hand.
Our whole school turns this way.
Is everything on this island edible?
I touch it first, then decide.
This smell does not come from the water.
I open my mouth, then close it, wary.
You shake your hand; crumbs sink toward me.
One bite only; I swim faster than you.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，整个群体散了。
lines.en: You step in and the whole school scatters.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下来，我们翻了一片。
lines.en: One step from you flips a whole patch of us.

lines.zh: 菌丝被搅起来，水变褐了。
lines.en: Mycelium churns up; the water turns brown.
Your boot brushes my back.
We bunch together, then scatter.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚踝，滑开了。
lines.en: I hit your ankle and slip away.

lines.zh: 水里全是碎菌丝，看不见。
lines.en: Shredded mycelium clouds the water.

lines.zh: 别踩，这里全是我们的卵。
lines.en: Do not step here; our eggs are everywhere.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，躲到巨菇根后。
lines.en: I slip past you behind a mushroom root.
The surface sways a long time before calming.

lines.zh: 我们一群里，只有我们成对。
lines.en: In the whole school, only we have paired.

lines.zh: 我绕着它游，背上的斑发亮。
lines.en: I circle it, the spots on my back bright.
There is a soft place beneath the mycelium.
It touches me with a fin, lightly.
We swim abreast, tails in rhythm.

lines.zh: 卵要藏在菌丝里才安全。
lines.en: The eggs are safe only hidden in mycelium.
When others come near, we chase them off.

lines.zh: 它的褐色比我的深一点。
lines.en: Its brown is a shade deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 八条鱼里，我们守着这一角。
lines.en: Among eight fish, we hold this corner.
Slowly; the island's water is in no hurry.

lines.zh: 网一收，我们全挤在网底。
lines.en: The net closes; we crowd its bottom.
Away from mycelium water I feel wrong.
I butt the net; my scales rasp.
The bucket water has no spore smell.

lines.zh: 你会把我倒进哪个池塘？
lines.en: Which pond will you pour me into?
I circle the bucket looking for mycelium.
I leap and hit the lid.
My schoolmates thrash inside the net.
Do not split us into separate buckets.
This water is too clear for my liking.
A shadow sways beyond the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我停下摆尾，一群都停了。
lines.en: I stop fanning; the school stops too.
Ripples push out from the shore.
Not a mooshroom; the steps are too light.
I turn, my back to my schoolmates.
Something has entered the water.
I sink my body against the mycelium.

lines.zh: 孢子被搅动，说明它在动。
lines.en: The spores stir, so it is moving.
I stare into that brown depth.

lines.zh: 巨菇的影子把水遮暗了。
lines.en: The giant mushroom's shadow darkens the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着菌丝游，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I skim the mycelium, closing in slowly.
It drifts slightly and we all follow.
The eight of us form a half circle.

lines.zh: 水里的孢子替我遮住身形。
lines.en: Spores in the water hide my shape.
I count how many tail-lengths remain.
If it goes up, I follow.
My gills work faster than usual.

lines.zh: 这张网一样的水，收紧了。
lines.en: The water tightens around it like a net.
I make no sound; we never do.
Just one more hand closer.
I butt its leg with little force.

lines.zh: 我们八个一起撞，像雨点。
lines.en: All eight of us strike like raindrops.
I bite and get only water.
My tail slaps it and wets a patch.
It lifts a foot and we all scatter.
My teeth cannot grip cloth.
After the strike I sink into the mycelium.
A fish with three hearts can only do this.
It retreats, and we close in again.
Fighting in water, we have numbers.

lines.zh: 我们在蘑菇岛的浅水里散开。
lines.en: We spread out in the mushroom island's shallows.
The bottom is mycelium, not sand.
The shore is all brown giant mushrooms.
Spores wash in with the water.
I flick my tail and try deeper water.
Eight fish, like a string of beads.
The sky here is low and grey.

lines.zh: 我闻到岛上潮湿的土味。
lines.en: I smell the island's damp earth.
With no predators, we are at ease.

lines.zh: 我先绕着巨菇根游一圈。
lines.en: First I swim once around a mushroom root.

lines.zh: 火落进水里，我躲到菌丝下。
lines.en: Fire falls into the water; I hide beneath mycelium.

lines.zh: 被甩到菌丝上，我弹了两下。
lines.en: Flung onto mycelium, I bounce twice.
Mycelium tangles me and I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 冲击把整片水底翻了上来。
lines.en: The blast turns the whole bottom over.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，钉在菌丝上。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the water and sticks in mycelium.
Light falls and every spore glows.

lines.zh: 岛上食物很多，可我吃不到。
lines.en: The island is rich in food I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 雷劈中巨菇，水底震了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes a giant mushroom; the bottom shakes.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有菌丝，我落得很快。
lines.en: No mycelium in the void; I fall fast.
